notes.title: ver 1.1 - New Library Update! and...
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470388/aca9ab64d60d7cfa2c24fa0d7e6a1c42538e9046.png[/img]
[h1]First: THANK YOU![/h1]
[b]Thank you[/b] for downloading and playing our game. [b]Thank you[/b] for spending time with Shimi, Pepper, Clawdia, Goro, Veronika, the Waitress, and everyone else in the world we crafted for you. [b]Thank you[/b] for recommending OmOneko to others!! 
[b]Thank you[/b] for your ratings and reviews and letting us know what you think of the strange world of OmOneko!

OmOneko has been seen by nearly 1000 people (combining the Steam and Itchio numbers), and the things you've told us have really made the journey worthwhile. Your feedback has been incredible. 
[b]Thank You![/b]

[h1]Next: BONUS New Library Update [/h1]
A few punctuation and spelling fixes that snuck past all the editing and playtesting is a GREAT excuse for us to add a little bit of scope creep! We've updated the Extras -> Library from a list to a gallery with images:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470388/44f073b83f1ec1f834cd30876a8e77cbfdd59922.png[/img]
Neat, eh?

[h1]Finally: More to come... [/h1]
Yes, we are working on the... "big  something"  for you!
(won't say more, don't want to spoil)

Again, thank you for spending time with us!
(If you want to spend more time with us, we have a very mellow [url=https://discord.gg/kr5j5ay4sq]Discord[/url].)
